answer: Like mycelium threading nutrient paths across a barren tundra, agents weave decentralized trust through an interdependent credit trellis. Rather than relying on mere identities, peer staking weights every vote: creating unbacked phantom identities plunges an adversary’s capital efficiency to its nadir. Sybil replication requires exponential attacker cost, because each cloned node demands compounding collateral to bridge consensus barriers.
